Cricket player's frustrated kick leads to unusual run-out, forces super over

In the DPL 2026, New Delhi Tigers captain Himmat Singh kicked a ball in frustration after a misfield. The ball struck the stumps, resulting in the run-out of a batsman on the final ball of the match. This unusual event forced the game into a super over.
